dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: One hundred thirty baht. Cash or QR code?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌn ˈhʌndrəd ˈθɜːrti ˈbɑːt. ˈkæʃ ɔːr ˌkjuːˈɑːr ˌkoʊd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: ˈkæʃ. hɪrz ə ˈθaʊzənd ˌbɑːt ˈbɪl.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Sorry, I don't have change. Can you pay by QR code?
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri, aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈhæv ˈtʃeɪndʒ. kən juː ˈpeɪ baɪ ˌkjuːˈɑːr ˌkoʊd?
